_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): signup form — username + password + confirm, posts to feature-auth's /auth/register, inline validation, 409 handling, auto-login hook. Composes comp-login (useAuth) + comp-http-client. Uses [[ ]] delimiters.
name: comp-signup
description: Signup form: username + password + confirm, register endpoint, validation, auto-login hook. Pairs feature-auth + comp-login.
notes: Backend contract: POST {apiBase}/auth/register {username,password} -> 201 {id,username,role,is_active,created_at}; 409 on duplicate username (feature-auth). Usage: <SignupForm apiBase='/api' onRegistered={(u,p) => { loginWith(u,p); }} /> — after register, call your login (e.g. post /auth/login) in onRegistered so the token flows into comp-http-client's auth. Wrap the whole auth flow (login/signup) in one parent that owns useAuth.
